hotels.title: Central Boutique Jerusalem Haven with Spa & Indoor Pool
hotels.description: Theatron Jerusalem Hotel & Spa MGallery Collection offers a boutique retreat in the historic Talbieh neighbourhood, just steps from Jerusalem Theatre. This boutique heritage haven is the perfect base for exploring Jerusalem's ancient streets, sacred sites and vibrant cultural scene. Unwind at the Spa by Clarins with its indoor pool and holistic treatments, or savour Mediterranean cuisine at Shorashim Lobby Bar. Explore nearby landmarks including the Western Wall, Dome of the Rock and Ben Yehuda Street's cafes and markets, then return to your tranquil sanctuary to reflect on the day's discoveries.
